title: Camera Coach capture manifest template v1
description: Operator template only. It contains no source data, rights grant, calibration result, or model output.

still.unit: one deliberate still decision per scene/take
requirements: capture one intentional frame after the operator settles the camera
do not count burst-adjacent frames as independent records
record any discarded burst as the same take_family_id and derivation family

temporal_sequence.unit: one complete live sequence per take
requirements: keep all frames in one source_shoot_id, take_family_id, and split
record monotonic timestamps and state transitions
do not split individual frames across train, calibration, or holdout

before_after_episode.unit: before frame, one named action, and after frame
requirements: preserve subject and scene continuity where the action is meant to be evaluated
label the outcome as correct, no_op, opposite, overshoot, track_loss, or incomparable
pilot each action with correct, no-op, and opposite examples before scaling

pilot_checklist.check: Each counted record is a deliberate source decision, not a burst neighbour, crop, color variant, or duplicated frame.
scene_family_id, take_family_id, time_family_id, device_family_id, and derivation_family_id are present and stable.
Pilot spans multiple devices, people, locations, portrait/landscape orientations, lenses, and lighting conditions.
A rights_record_id and consent_record_id are present; both dispositions and allowed uses resolve before admission.
Before/after pilot includes correct, no-op, and opposite outcomes for each exercised action.
A source shoot, scene, take, time, person, location, device, and derivation family occurs in one split only.
Manifest entry hashes and operator/date are retained outside raw media storage.
